model_sql:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT customer_id, status, order_id
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }}
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LOWER(status)) = 'shipped' THEN order_id END) AS shipped,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LOWER(status)) = 'pending' THEN order_id END) AS pending,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LOWER(status)) = 'cancelled' THEN order_id END) AS cancelled
FROM src
GROUP BY customer_id

WITH src AS (
    SELECT customer_id, status, order_id
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }}
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LOWER(status)) = 'shipped' THEN order_id END) AS shipped,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LOWER(status)) = 'pending' THEN order_id END) AS pending,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN RTRIM(LOWER(status)) = 'cancelled' THEN order_id END) AS cancelled
FROM src
GROUP BY customer_id

explanation: This procedure counts each customer's orders by status, producing one row per customer with separate counts for shipped, pending and cancelled orders. Customers whose orders have no matching status still appear, with zeros in those columns. The rewrite matches status values case-insensitively and ignores trailing spaces, as SQL Server does by default.
